name: st_lrps_ablation
description: ST-LRPS ablation suite (A0..A6 ladder from raw xyz to the shipped model, one component per step). Secondary evidence: does not block final-candidate evidence generation. Every arm trains once per seed; all runs share one dataset split (split_seed, default the first seed) and the train-only scaler.

dataset.train_data: <FILL: residual cloud HDF5 (same dataset as final candidates)>

note: matrix='default' runs A0..A6; 'all' adds the optional A8/A9 encodings and the legacy deviations. Set execute=true to launch training; default is dry-run (commands + manifest only). Ablation is expensive and optional.
